item.title: Playhead 0.1.0 (build 7)
item.description:
**Android TV** - This is the first build delivered through the in-app updater: Playhead on Android shows "Install update". The first time, Android asks you to allow Playhead to install apps. - Remote navigation: Left always reaches the sidebar, and Back goes to the sidebar before leaving the app. The rail expands with labels while you're in it. - On TV, the update card's "Install update" button takes focus when the card appears. - The indexer catalogue and sources load on Android. HTTPS was failing with "expect rustls-platform-verifier to be initialized". - Onboarding keeps the focused button on screen when the step changes.
**macOS** - Same fixes. Updates arrive through the usual update window.
Windows stays on build 6 for this release.
